subject: POC environment: connectivity & secrets next steps (VPC peering, SSO, KMS)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brightview.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment: connectivity & secrets next steps (VPC peering, SSO, KMS)

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) milestone for the POC environment so we have clear owners and dates. Attached: MAP-draft-BrightView.xlsx and a simple network diagram (bv-vpc-diagram.png).

Summary of POC environment dependencies we discussed:
- VPC peering (or PrivateLink) between BrightView dev account and Redwood staging account
- IP allowlist for Redwood egress (we'll provide specific ranges)
- SSO/SAML configuration (Okta) for engineering and product SSO during the POC
- Secrets management: customer-managed KMS key and short-lived secrets via our Secrets API

Proposed milestone sheet (high level):
1) Exchange account IDs & VPC CIDRs — owner: BrightView (due: 2027-06-11)
2) Open peering request + security review — owner: BrightView infra (due: 2027-06-15)
3) Sharing SAML metadata & cert exchange for Okta — owner: BrightView SSO team & Redwood (due: 2027-06-16)
4) KMS key provisioning & IAM roles for Redwood service account — owner: BrightView cloud team (due: 2027-06-18)
5) Smoke tests + signoff (connectivity, TLS, secret rotation) — owner: joint (target: 2027-06-22)

Target POC start: week of 2027-06-22 (flexible by a few days depending on when peering and SSO are finished).

Questions for you:
- Can you confirm the owner(s) for peering and KMS so we can add specific assignees in the MAP sheet?
- Any compliance constraints on cross-account peering (e.g., must go through a transit VPC)?
- Does your security team require an architecture review before we open the peering?

Next steps: I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with names once you confirm owners. If helpful we can schedule a 30-min runbook walk-through between your infra and our platform ops (Jonas) this week.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment: connectivity & secrets next steps (VPC peering, SSO, KMS)

Thanks Karthik — good notes. Samir (our infra lead) and I reviewed this and here are our answers / constraints: 

- Owners: Samir Patel (infra) will own VPC peering and KMS provisioning; I will coordinate SSO/Okta.
- AWS account IDs (dev): 111122223333 (BV-dev), 111122223334 (BV-staging) — we will provide a cross-account role for Redwood.
- We prefer customer-managed KMS keys and strict key rotation. No long-lived static API keys to be stored in your environment — Redwood should use our CMK and assume-role flow.
- SAML: Okta is our IdP. We'll provide metadata URL and require SP-initiated SSO for the POC.
- Regarding peering: we prefer classic VPC peering (no transit VPC) for the POC; if performance issues arise we can revisit.

One follow-up question: does Redwood need specific CIDR ranges inbound for your worker pool, or do you provide a stable set of egress IPs? We can open an allowlist for a set of ranges if you provide them.

We can meet for the runbook walkthrough on Thu 2027-06-10 (10:00 PT) — Samir will join.

Laura

--
Laura Chen

I'll confirm the peering request ID after I open it. Target: smoke testing week of 2027-06-22 as discussed.
